title: Use Seedance 2.5 with multiple text prompts (e.g., 4 prompts) to stitch…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 with multiple text prompts (e.g., 4 prompts) to stitch together longer documentaries (2+ minutes) in hours.  
Use reference inputs plus refined prompts in Seedance 2.5 to maintain consistency across long, unedited multi-prompt videos.  
Generate a 30s text-to-video clip in Seedance 2.5 including narration, then add soft background music and subtitles in CapCut.
